profile: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing therapeutics, initially focused on eye care. Its marketed product XDEMVY is an ophthalmic solution for Demodex blepharitis. The company also investigates lotilaner-based candidates, including a gel formulation for ocular rosacea and an oral tablet for Lyme disease prophylaxis and community malaria reduction, serving patients with these conditions.
